description: Create campaign. Create a new mail campaign. Each step can reference an existing design or provide a design_prompt to generate one; designs are HTML, so generation is instant (no polling required). Provide at most one audience type: property IDs, contact IDs, or saved list IDs. With an audience, set launch=true to send immediately, or leave it as a draft and call POST /campaigns/{id}/send later. Set accepts_properties=true to keep adding properties with POST /campaigns/{id}/properties after it starts; without it the campaign works as before and ends when its mail is done. Without an audience, the campaign is saved as ready with no properties and no charge, and it accepts properties: add them any time with POST /campaigns/{id}/properties. Saving as ready needs a name that does not start with "Draft - " and a design on every step. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

accepts_properties.description: Keep the campaign open to new properties after it starts, so POST /v1/mail/campaigns/{id}/properties can add more while it is ready, active or paused. Defaults to false when an audience is given, and the campaign ends when its mail is done, as before. A campaign created without an audience is saved as ready and always accepts properties, so false is refused there.

address_to.description: Who to address mail to: owner (mailing address) or resident (property address). Required when using property_ids and for property-based list_ids. Not needed for contact_ids or people lists.

contact_ids.description: Contact (person) IDs to send to. Mutually exclusive with property_ids and list_ids. Pass an ID above the JSON safe integer range (2^53 - 1) as a decimal string.

launch.description: Launch the campaign immediately after creation. Requires an audience. If false, a campaign with an audience is created in draft status and a campaign without one is saved as ready.

list_ids.description: Saved list IDs to send to. Mutually exclusive with property_ids and contact_ids.

property_ids.description: Property IDs to send to. Mutually exclusive with contact_ids and list_ids. Omit all three audience fields to save the campaign as Ready with no properties; add properties later with POST /v1/mail/campaigns/{id}/properties.

qr_code_url.description: URL for the QR code on the postcard

return_address_id.description: ID of a saved return address

steps.description: Mail steps (1-5). Each step can reference an existing design or provide a prompt.

delay_days.description: Days to wait after the previous step

design_prompt.description: Prompt to generate an HTML design on the fly

repeat_count.description: How many times to send this step (1-12)

skip_if_responded.description: Skip this step if the recipient has responded

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_mail_campaigns
